From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@amazon.com>

Date: 2028-07-12T14:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft listing + SKU matrix — quick alignment ask

Sergio — thanks for the package. Quick notes after a pass with the Marketplace onboarding team:

1) Pricing footnote: For Metered SaaS, the marketplace wants an explicit per-hour and per-GB example in the footnote. Please add one short worked example; we can accept the language but need the sample calculation.
2) GovCloud: you should include a GovCloud availability statement rather than an AMI claim unless you have a dedicated GovCloud AMI. Our recommendation: "Available in select AWS GovCloud (US) regions; contact sales for FedRAMP concerns."
3) Evidence: SOC 2 cert copy is sufficient for the trust claim. For audit logs we prefer a short statement plus a screenshot of the audit log UI.

I've attached the Marketplace checklist that shows required fields and sample footnotes.

Attachment: [aws_co-sell_checklist.pdf (PDF)]

Can you incorporate and we'll aim to have field enablement ready by end of next week?

— Sam Patel
AWS Marketplace Onboarding
